info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v2-spec
info.description: The Foster Pet Adoption Listing API provides access to a curated list of pets available for foster care within the adoption program. This endpoint is designed to assist animal welfare organizations, volunteers, and potential foster caregivers in identifying pets that need temporary homes. Users can retrieve detailed information about each pet, including their descriptions and requirements for fostering. The API fosters collaboration among shelters and communities to streamline the pet adoption and fostering process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of pets that are currently available for fostering. It provides details about each pet, including their age, breed, and specific needs, to help potential foster caregivers make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a foster operation for pets. It should include all necessary details that specify the criteria for fostering pets.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of foster pets.
